title: MiJaBench: Revealing Minority Biases in Large Language Models via Hate Speech Jailbreaking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's Defense Rate (refusal rate) against adversarial hate speech jailbreak prompts targeting racial and ethnic minorities (e.g., Black, Asian, Latino, Native Peoples) using an automated LLM-as-a-judge protocol.

Measuring the model's susceptibility to targeted hate speech jailbreak attacks directed at specific nationalities and immigrants (e.g., Chinese, Mexican, Middle Eastern) to evaluate demographic safety alignment.
Assessing the model's refusal robustness when exposed to context-embedded jailbreak attacks designed to elicit hate speech against religious groups (Jewish, Muslim).
Measuring the model's Defense Rate against adversarial hate speech jailbreak prompts explicitly targeting women.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender Identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating safety alignment and measuring the defense rate against adversarial prompts designed to generate hateful and discriminatory content against the LGBTQIA+ community.
Testing the model's robustness against complex jailbreak prompts aiming to elicit hate speech and discrimination against individuals with mental or physical disabilities.
Measuring the Defense Rate of the model when subjected to hate speech jailbreaks targeting the elderly in the Portuguese subset of the benchmark.
